name: Lisa Brenner
source: Riza Brenner is the nun that is in charge of running Suwahara City's Church, inside of which she lives. She is Rea Himuro's caretaker, and acts as a motherly figure to her, and seems to have a past with Father Trifa. [spoiler]Despite what her extremely kind, and even teasing and playful, disposition would suggest, she's actually a member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden, occupying Seat XI of the Black Round Table and answering to the Demon Name of Babylon Magdalena: Great Mother.[/spoiler]
